subject: Error in dbPreExists && !overwrite : invalid 'x' type in 'x && y'

messages.author: af1128a04b090701
messages.subject: Error in dbPreExists && !overwrite : invalid 'x' type in 'x && y'
parts:
Can you please explain what type of error this is? I get this by executing long (but valid) sql query:


drv <- dbDriver("PostgreSQL")
con <- dbConnect(drv, dbname="dbname",host="host",port=5432,user="usr",password="pwd")

# vSQL is sql query string
vSQLDF <- sqldf(vSQL, connection=con)

I get:

Error in dbPreExists && !overwrite : invalid 'x' type in 'x && y'

I've tried to update R and all packages, but still no luck. Running PostgreSQL 9.1.

messages.subject: Re: Error in dbPreExists && !overwrite : invalid 'x' type in 'x && y'

I don't think manual connections were ever tested with postgres.  Use RPostgreSQL directly if you want to use those. 

Manual and automatic connections do work in sqldf with sqlite and automatic connecteions do work in sqldf with RPostgreSQL: For the last one see below:

> library(RPostgreSQL)
Loading required package: DBI
> library(sqldf)
...
> sqldf('select * from "BOD" ', verbose = TRUE)
sqldf: library(RPostgreSQL)
sqldf: m <- dbDriver("PostgreSQL")
sqldf: connection <- dbConnect(m, user='postgres', password=<...>, dbname = 'test', host = 'localhost', port = '5432')
Loading required package: tcltk
sqldf: dbWriteTable(connection, 'BOD', BOD, row.names = FALSE)
sqldf: dbGetQuery(connection, 'select * from "BOD" ')
